blame.title: The Montgomery Advertiser (Montgomery, Ala.), 1917-12-14
blame.description: Imo helmsman Johansen arrested as a spy suspect amid wild rumours; the official inquiry opens under Justice Drysdale with lawyers for both ships, the city and the pilots.

blame.description: Fix blame at Halifax: pilot Mackey and Captain Le Medec held responsible by the commission; both arrested and charged with manslaughter.

blame.title: The Bridgeport Times and Evening Farmer (Bridgeport, Conn.), 1918-02-05
blame.description: Pilot Mackey and Captain Le Medec of the Mont-Blanc charged with manslaughter; examination officer Wyatt arrested after the Drysdale inquiry censured him.
blame.credit: The Bridgeport Times and Evening Farmer (Bridgeport, Conn.), 1918-02-05

blame.title: Every Evening (Wilmington, Del.), 1918-03-20
blame.description: Commander Wyatt, chief examining officer of the port, indicted for manslaughter by the grand jury although the judge said the evidence did not justify it.

blame.title: Evening Times-Republican (Marshalltown, Iowa), 1918-04-20
blame.description: Justice Drysdale's admiralty decision places the whole blame for the collision on the Mont Blanc.

blame.title: The Birmingham Age-Herald (Birmingham, Ala.), 1919-05-23
blame.description: Supreme Court in Ottawa reverses Drysdale: responsibility rests equally on the Mont Blanc and the Imo; the Imo's owners will appeal to the Privy Council.
